initial_budget_design: Identical reaudited historical schedules; identical additional ALNS budgets; historical preprocessing/selection is separate
limitations: Artificial uncalibrated cost units and coordinate distances; no empirical monetary savings
Limited ALNS/exact budgets; cost optimality only where MILP proof exists; no global minimum pool proof
Fixed starts/ends, common cutoff per batch, unrestricted concurrent cleaning capacity
Regression tests ran concurrently during part of this screening experiment; no uncontended runtime or convergence claims

items.assessment: 逐例方向均为测试成本下降；不合并坐标距离与道路公里推断真实费用。
结论限于给定优化场景，不推断企业或单件包裹实际经济收益。
7个有目的选取的代表场景，仅作探索验证，不代表186个配置总体。
按最低成本选解是明示决策规则，箱数不是最小箱数估计；没有回归控制分析。
完整报告84次尝试、78个有效解、6次无解限时及7个完整对照。
两组使用同一起点和新增预算；有限随机搜索仍不能证明大场景收敛。
6次限时无解和所有种子均保留；没有删除不利箱数变化。
无显著性检验；7例全部展示，全部原始运行保留。
费用不调整；界和预算显式冻结；属于探索实验，不是预注册确认研究。
3个小例有数学成本最优证明；大例只报告已观察可行解，不推断真实运营因果收益。
模型内时间先后由路线、回收和清洗约束确定；不作观察数据方向性因果推断。

reproducibility.method: independent deterministic replay, row-cost/stock recomputation and frozen hash checks; stochastic optimization not rerun

postprocessing_notes: Validation appendix and distinct actual recovery-round counts added after frozen solver run, from original audited result JSON; solver source remains identical.
